NF5 Family Limited Partnership, Intervenor, Opposing Link M22
SOAH DOCKET NO. 473-26–16349
PUC DOCKET NO. 59475

NF5 FAMILY LIMITED PARTNERSHIP EXCEPTIONS TO THE PFD

COMES NOW, NF5, by Wade Noelke, to submit its Exceptions to the PFD in this case. 
Introduction
Intervenor NF5’s last filed document in this case was its Post Hearing Reply Brief. See Item #6389. 
The PFD does not approve any route going through NF5’s Noelke-Wilhelm ranch (it opposes all Routes involving Link M22, specifically on Tracts 508 and 509, including Routes 547, 548, 295, 296 and 297).
The PFD recommends denial of the CCNs in 59475 and 59182. NF5 agrees with the PFD’s qualitative recommendation.
Additionally, NF5 aligns itself with the American Stewards of Liberty, the Texas Attorney General’s Office, certain members of the Texas House of Representatives and Senate, and other individuals and organizations, who argue Applicants failed to establish a need for this project.

Applicants did not directly or indirectly rebut any fact NF5 has admitted into evidence.
11. Changes to the PFD
NF5 agrees with the conclusion of the PFD that the CCN’s in both 59475 and 59182 should be denied. It recommends no additional Findings of Fact or Conclusions of Law for the PFD.
NF5 specifically supports Conclusion of Law Number 13, which finds ERCOT’s Permian Basin Reliability Project recommendation is not entitled to great weight in the determination of need for this reliability project.  PFD page 195.
WHEREFORE, PREMISES CONSIDERED, Intervenor NF5 respectfully prays the Findings of Fact and Conclusion that support the denial of CCN 59475 and 59182 must be AFFIRMED.
Signed September 2, 2026

Respectfully submitted,


/s/ Wade Noelke
Wade Noelke
NF5 Family Limited Partnership
Intervenor

















CERTIFICATE OF SERVICE

/s/ Wade Noelke
